description: The months #budgets generates (see main.zhang), with the clock at 2024-03-01 03:00 UTC, still 2024-02-29 in the ledger's timezone, so the current month is February 2024.

requests.bql: SELECT name, min(date) AS first, max(date) AS last, count(*) AS months FROM #budgets GROUP BY name ORDER BY name
SELECT name, date FROM #budgets WHERE date = yearmonth(today())
SELECT name, count(*) AS months FROM #budgets WHERE date <= 2023-12-01 GROUP BY name ORDER BY name
SELECT name, min(date) AS first, max(date) AS last FROM #budgets WHERE date >= 2024-03-01 GROUP BY name ORDER BY name
